participants_id.Description: A unique identifier for this participant at DANDI.

donor_nhash_id.Description: The unique NHash identifier for this participant (Donor) at NIMP Analytics (see https://brain-specimenportal.org/nimp_analytics).

donor_local_id.Description: LIMS specimen identifier of the donor animal. Corresponds to donor_local_id in mapping.tsv.

species_name.Description: The common name for the species of the participant.

species_ncbi_taxon.Description: The NCBI Taxonomy identifier for the species of the participant.

injection_target_region.Description: Brain region targeted for stereotaxic injection of retrograde tracer used to label the projection-defined population profiled in this participant.

injection_target_brain_structure_id_homb.Description: HOMBA ontology identifier for the injection_target_region.

injection_target_brain_structure_name_ho.Description: HOMBA ontology name for the injection_target_region.

injection_target_brain_structure_id_ccf.Description: Allen Common Coordinate Framework (CCF-2020) ontology identifier for the injection_target_region. Left blank where the target (e.g. spinal cord) falls outside the CCF mouse brain atlas.

injection_target_brain_structure_name_cc.Description: Allen Common Coordinate Framework (CCF-2020) ontology name for the injection_target_region. Left blank where the target (e.g. spinal cord) falls outside the CCF mouse brain atlas.

nimp_resource_visualizer_url.Description: The URL for this participant/Donor in the NIMP Analytics Resource Visualizer.
